policy: Application release checks are disabled for InlongSlicer.
behavior: The automatic/direct application-check entry returns before URL preparation and HTTP.
Normal and force-upgrade event handlers suppress queued application update dialogs.
Help-menu and command-palette update actions and the stable-only preference are removed.
Profile and plugin synchronization is independent of the application-version flag. Its worker body is unchanged; removing a guard that was previously always false preserves execution.

affected_fan_knowledge_review.conclusion: All profile, cooling and prior evidence snapshots are unchanged. Only PresetUpdater.cpp changed, exclusively its application-version flag and the redundant worker guard. Fan/profile calculations and the profile/plugin worker body are unchanged. Original fan measurements remain historical.

branding_scan.review: The only added Orca reference identifies independently managed upstream releases in a source comment. Existing external service/wiki URLs, plugin ABI and import compatibility names, upstream/dependency provenance and historical records are retained. No identity, asset or URL was renamed.

limits: No interactive GUI session was launched. Disabled request/dialog behavior is established by audited entry guards and the compiled Release binding; CLI load was checked natively.
Only the named build/src/Release runtime was rebuilt; the two existing package outputs were preserved.
No new slicing benchmark was run; unchanged core source and libraries preserve the previously tested slicing implementation.
